We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 3 reactions using templates 1914393, 1914394, 1914395 in this order.

We applied template 1914393 to target molecule, got result: a tuple with two SMILES: ('COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1', 'FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1'). So the reaction splits target into two fragments: fragment A = COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1 (the core without the side chain) and fragment B = FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1 (a fluorinated piperidine with a chlorophenyl). Good.

Now we need to apply template 1914394 to one of these fragments (presumably the first fragment). We attempted apply_template on fragment A with template 1914394, got empty result. Maybe need to apply to fragment B? Let's try on fragment B.
